Tip: If Secure Boot is not enabled in the factory, it can be enabled later by the customer. However once
Secure Boot is enabled, it cannot be disabled.

Operating system support
The SC777 V4 supports the following operating systems:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6
Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.0
Ubuntu 24.04 LTS 64-bit
See Operating System Interoperability Guide (OSIG) for the complete list of supported, certifei d, and tested
operating systems, including version and point releases:
https://lenovopress.lenovo.com/osig#servers=sc777-v4-7dmp
Also review the latest LeSI Best Recipe to see the operating systems that are supported via Lenovo Scalable
Infrastructure (LeSI):
